function.name: system_status
function.description: Report PC health: CPU load, memory, battery, disk space or network. Example: what is my PC battery.

function.name: find_file
function.description: Search the allowed folders for files by name, type, folder or time. Example: find the PDF I downloaded yesterday.

function.name: open_app
function.description: Open an application on the PC by common name. Example: open Chrome.

function.name: open_url
function.description: Open a website or run a web search in the default browser. Example: search Google for best laptops.

function.name: media_control
function.description: Control music or video playback. Example: skip to the next song.

function.name: set_volume
function.description: Change the PC volume. Example: set the volume to 30 percent.

function.name: lock_pc
function.description: Lock the PC screen. Example: lock my computer.

function.name: take_screenshot
function.description: Capture the screen or the active window and send the image to the phone. Example: take a screenshot.

function.name: open_file
function.description: Open one file by name from the allowed folders. Example: open the file called project proposal.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Move one named file to the Recycle Bin after the user confirms. Example: delete the file called old notes.

function.name: escalate
function.description: Hand the request to the big brain when it is a question or chat, needs several steps, is not covered by these tools, is risky, or is unclear.
